title: Ella Fitzgerald: too serious about her work
summary: Humes jokes that Ella should retire from the Grammy competition. They agree Ella is conscientious to a fault, fusses and gets upset with sidemen, and Gus Johnson had to calm her down.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
